name: USx Tenant Testing -- Driver + Capture
description: Drives the universal-search query form and captures dex-log request XML on any Mark43 tenant, feeding the post_test pipeline. In-browser; no cert needed. ARMED PER TENANT -- the on-screen switch is the safety, see ui.js.
_comment_hosts: v0.5.0 (2026-08-13, Rob: 'open up access to all tenants with the tail end of the url'):
the eight enumerated usx-*.mark43.com hosts were replaced by a single wildcard so a new
tenant needs no manifest edit -- HDLE Foundation (hdle-foundation.mark43.com) does not fit
the usx- naming pattern and was simply never matched, which is why nothing loaded there.
READ THIS BEFORE WIDENING IT FURTHER. The manifest allowlist WAS the safety mechanism: the
extension could only ever act on the eight provider test tenants. A wildcard removes that,
and it did so on the same day PRODUCTION started existing (CA_CLETS went live at Mariposa,
2026-08-13) -- so this now injects into live sites where real officers run real CJIS queries.
The replacement safety is the ARM SWITCH in ui.js: disarmed by default, per-hostname, and
every action button refuses while disarmed. Do not remove it, and do not default it to on.
